title: Fanin bound for pairwise XOR construction
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every finite list of pairs of circuits on $n$ variables, applying the pairwise XOR construction yields a list whose pair fanin is at most the maximum of $2$ and the original list's pair fanin.
hypotheses_covered: the input is a finite list of pairs of circuits on $n$ variables
